_comment: T-512, the combo multiplier's text (HUD and menus, Content, 'The multiplier beside the car'); T-514 reads it, no text in code. Each line scored 8 or more in the style loop (T-512's Style review). {multiplier} and {amount} are numbers built by code. Bangers has capitals only, so the HUD shows these in capitals (x2.50 shows as X2.50).
multiplier_comment: The combo multiplier beside the car, {multiplier} with two decimals (for example x2.50). No label word.
gain_comment: A trick popup's amount after the trick name: the multiplier the trick added (for example +x0.5). Replaces '+{amount}' viewers (hud.gd ADDED_TEXT). The style loop scored the form '+X{amount}!' 9/10; the '!' is dropped here because the amount follows the popup's own '!' name.
loss_comment: What a crash cut from the multiplier, falling away from the number beside the car (for example -x1.5). Replaces '-{amount}' viewers (hud.gd LOST_TEXT). Optional: the UI may show nothing instead.
unused_comment: Texts of the live viewers counter that no longer appear once T-514 removes the counter.
